//: jsx is required HERE too, and not only in apps/web (M0-T8). This project has no
`.tsx` of its own, but it imports `@smarttavern/web/mount`, and tsc follows that
import into `apps/web/src/**/*.tsx` — so the web package's TSX files are compiled
as part of THIS program. Without the setting the failure is reported against a
FILE IN ANOTHER WORKSPACE (TS6142, `app.tsx`: '--jsx' is not set) from a project
that does not contain it, which is exactly the class of error only a root
`tsc -b` sees — the per-package `typecheck` scripts cannot catch it.
The exclude is `src/**/*.test.*` rather than `src/**/*.test.ts` so a future
`.test.tsx` cannot slip past it; see apps/web/tsconfig.json for the full reasoning.
